top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §746.5207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency evacuation diagrams that are posted in the classroom do not indicate the relocation center outside of the child care center or the shelter in place location(s).

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

top_violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the nap cots were set up in a way that did not provide adequate space for caregivers to walk and work in between.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(25))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information needs to be added in the operational policies/parent handbook regarding provisions for breastfeeding mothers, and their right to breastfeed or provide breast milk.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies do not address duration of physical activities.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include the criteria used to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play
